title: Advanced Patterns & Capstone
description: Study contradictions and uncertain relations, graph embeddings and symbolic edges, choosing graphrag for a workload, and capstone: a provenance-rich research graph. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Contradictions and uncertain relations
lessons.description: Design an answer that cites both claims and states the uncertainty.
lessons.conceptOverview: Preserve contradictory assertions with their sources and temporal scope. An answer can report disagreement instead of choosing whichever claim was indexed last.
lessons.whyItMatters: Conflicting assertions should remain visible until resolved.

sections.content: Design an answer that cites both claims and states the uncertainty. Write down your reasoning and check it against the concept before continuing.

keyTakeaways: Conflicting assertions should remain visible until resolved.
commonMistakes: The last ingested assertion is necessarily correct.

lessons.title: Graph embeddings and symbolic edges
lessons.description: Specify separate storage and display for predicted and evidenced links.
lessons.conceptOverview: Graph embeddings encode structural patterns for similarity or prediction, while explicit edges represent recorded assertions. A predicted link should remain distinguishable from a sourced relation.
lessons.whyItMatters: Predicted links are hypotheses rather than sourced facts.

lessons.title: Choosing GraphRAG for a workload
lessons.description: State why a graph may help and what baseline must be tested.
lessons.conceptOverview: Use graph structure when relation traversal, entity aggregation or corpus-wide themes add measurable value. Consider extraction errors, update frequency and access complexity before adopting it.
lessons.whyItMatters: Architecture choice should follow measurable query requirements.

lessons.title: Capstone: a provenance-rich research graph
lessons.description: Deliver a schema, evidence records, query set and error analysis.
lessons.conceptOverview: Build a small graph from versioned reports with aliases, conflicting facts and at least one multi-hop query. Compare against text retrieval and verify every cited path against source passages.
lessons.whyItMatters: A useful capstone tests ambiguity, provenance and a baseline.
